test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: J, K, L, M and N live on different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it is numbered 2, and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 5. K and N live on the topmost and bottommost floors, respectively. J lives on the floor immediately above L. M lives on the floor immediately above N. Who lives on the second floor?
solution:
From the given information:

Step 1: K and N live on the topmost and bottommost floors, respectively. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/396dc458bdea5b7f1964fef941b1946ce120ca64eed3954eb5abed9a56d50040.png] We place K on top and N on bottom.

Step 2: M lives on the floor immediately above N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a28d8da764a76f53d9fe99e953786476e6931f45f266e178a068f8cb0230bdda.png] Now we place M above N.

Step 3: J lives on the floor immediately above L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2064f7a62476ecaa11bab6da72296405740561b46ba48313e8099dbbea0eb07f.png] Now we have to place J and L such that J is above L. 

From the arrangement, we can see that **M lives on second floor.**

Hence,** the correct answer is option 3).**
